candidates.statement: Checkout 502s stem from payment authorization calls timing out: gateway traces show POST payment to /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s) while inventory reservations succeed, propagating 502 up through order and checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side latency metrics/logs not admitted; whether the timeout is payment slowness vs network is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment authorization ReadTimeouts (~2s) causing 502s on orders/checkout while inventory/redis succeed; metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Bounded to downstream payment latency; payment-side telemetry still needed to confirm.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics to confirm payment-side slowness
Payment service logs for the ReadTimeout window
Gateway logs (excluded) to corroborate timeout origin
